name: Glassmorphism
definition: A design style using frosted glass effect with background blur and transparency. Creates a modern, premium aesthetic.
useCase: Modern UI cards, modals, and overlays for a premium aesthetic.
example: Our project cards use glassmorphism with backdrop blur.
prompt: Style this card with glassmorphism. Use background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), backdrop-filter: blur(10px), and a subtle border. Make it semi-transparent with a frosted glass appearance.
